messages.content: ترجم كل وحدة إنجليزية إلى العربية الفصحى بدقة واكتمال، مع حفظ المعنى والأسماء والإشارات الكتابية. لا تضف أسماء أو معلومات غير موجودة في النص، ولا تكتب ملاحظات أو شروحاً. أخرج JSON مطابقاً للمخطط فقط. يجب أن تكون chapter وverse عددين صحيحين بأرقام 0-9، وأن يكون text_ar ترجمة الوحدة وحدها.

{"chapter":6,"book_code":"2ES","verses":[{"chapter":6,"text":"“On the second day, again you made the spirit of the firmament and commanded it to divide and to separate the waters, that the one part might go up, and the other remain beneath.","verse":41},{"chapter":6,"text":"“On the third day, you commanded that the waters should be gathered together in the seventh part of the earth. You dried up six parts and kept them, to the intent that of these some being both planted and tilled might serve before you.","verse":42},{"chapter":6,"text":"For as soon as your word went out, the work was done.","verse":43},{"chapter":6,"text":"Immediately, great and innumerable fruit grew, with many pleasant tastes, and flowers of inimitable color, and fragrances of most exquisite smell. This was done the third day.","verse":44},{"chapter":6,"text":"“On the fourth day, you commanded that the sun should shine, the moon give its light, and the stars should be in their order;","verse":45},{"chapter":6,"text":"and gave them a command to serve mankind, who was to be made.","verse":46},{"chapter":6,"text":"“On the fifth day, you said to the seventh part, where the water was gathered together, that it should produce living creatures, fowls and fishes; and so it came to pass","verse":47},{"chapter":6,"text":"that the mute and lifeless water produced living things as it was told, that the nations might therefore praise your wondrous works.","verse":48},{"chapter":6,"text":"“Then you preserved two living creatures. The one you called Behemoth, and the other you called Leviathan.","verse":49},{"chapter":6,"text":"You separated the one from the other; for the seventh part, namely, where the water was gathered together, might not hold them both.","verse":50},{"chapter":6,"text":"To Behemoth, you gave one part, which was dried up on the third day, that he should dwell in it, in which are a thousand hills;","verse":51},{"chapter":6,"text":"but to Leviathan you gave the seventh part, namely, the watery part. You have kept them to be devoured by whom you wish, when you wish.","verse":52},{"chapter":6,"text":"“But on the sixth day, you commanded the earth to produce before you cattle, animals, and creeping things.","verse":53},{"chapter":6,"text":"Over these, you ordained Adam as ruler over all the works that you have made. Of him came all of us, the people whom you have chosen.","verse":54},{"chapter":6,"text":"“All this have I spoken before you, O Lord, because you have said that for our sakes you made this world.","verse":55},{"chapter":6,"text":"As for the other nations, which also come from Adam, you have said that they are nothing, and are like spittle. You have likened the abundance of them to a drop that falls from a bucket.","verse":56},{"chapter":6,"text":"Now, O Lord, behold these nations, which are reputed as nothing, being rulers over us and devouring us.","verse":57},{"chapter":6,"text":"But we your people, whom you have called your firstborn, your only children, and your fervent lover, are given into their hands.","verse":58},{"chapter":6,"text":"Now if the world is made for our sakes, why don’t we possess our world for an inheritance? How long will this endure?”","verse":59}]}
